categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names, and property details) in various locations. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
